findings.location: ci/checks/auto-sanction-additive.sh:318-320 (corpus_ref == SELFTEST_SKIP branch) + signature :233-235 (no self-test mode param)
findings.issue: The R-1a fix introduced a hardcoded sentinel string `SELFTEST_SKIP` that bypasses the ENTIRE corpus-anchor verification (reachability + ancestor-of-HEAD + blob-equality). The bypass is keyed PURELY on the literal value of vrag_attestation.corpus_ref in the JSON sanction line and is NOT gated to self-test invocation — attestation_valid() takes no mode flag, and the live standalone path (line 823) and --verify path (line 417) call it with the real sanction line verbatim. A task authoring a live `auto_additive` sanction can therefore set `"corpus_ref":"SELFTEST_SKIP"` and the R-1a content-binding (the ADR §2-Q2 'детерминированный якорь … не подделать') is silently skipped in production. This is a partial REOPENING of the exact R-1a hole this commit set out to close: the audit artifact stops proving which corpus the Враг ran against. The code comment says 'for --self-test mode' but nothing enforces it. Scope of damage is bounded (A-1..A-4 still block destructive thaws; R-1b families binding and enemy_segment still enforced — so this is NOT a destructive-thaw bypass), but on the security meta-gate the corpus-anchor integrity is exactly the load-bearing property R-1 was filed for, and a self-inflicted ungated escape hatch is a silent stated-vs-actual divergence — the same defect class as the original R-1.
findings.suggestion: Gate SELFTEST_SKIP to actual self-test invocation only. Add a self-test-mode parameter to attestation_valid() (e.g. `attestation_valid <json> [thawed_file] [allow_selftest_skip]`), pass it as true ONLY from the --self-test block, and false (default) from --verify and the live standalone loop. When not in self-test mode, treat corpus_ref==SELFTEST_SKIP as a FAIL ('sentinel not permitted in a live sanction'). Alternatively drop the sentinel entirely and have the self-test build a real ephemeral git repo with a real corpus commit (the probe in this review did exactly that in ~10 lines). Add a self-test case asserting that SELFTEST_SKIP is REJECTED in live (non-self-test) mode.

findings.issue: R-1b binds families to the thawed file by `echo "$enforced_files" | grep -qF "$file_basename"` — a SUBSTRING (not exact-line) match. A future foreign frozen check whose basename is a proper substring of a legitimately-enforced filename (e.g. a hypothetical ci/checks/isolation.sh vs the enforced object-handle-isolation.sh) would falsely satisfy the binding for an unrelated family. Exhaustive sweep confirms ZERO such collisions among the 110 current files, so it is NOT a live hole — and the attacker controls only the thawed basename, not the family's enforced-path list. Latent looseness only, strictly tighter than the prior no-binding state.
findings.suggestion: Use an exact match against the full enforced-path set: `echo "$enforced_files" | grep -qxF "$thawed_file"` (compare the full ci/checks/... relative path, not the basename), so binding is exact. Add a self-test case for a substring-basename non-collision.

summary: R-1 is PARTIALLY closed. r1a (stale/foreign corpus anchor): genuinely fixed for real git shas — verified against a constructed adversarial history (ancestor-but-truncated-blob REJECTED, foreign sha REJECTED, correct HEAD ACCEPTED). r1b (families surface-binding): genuinely fixed — TENANT-ISO for object-handle-isolation.sh REJECTED, correct family ACCEPTED, exhaustive 110x12 sweep = 0 holes. Destructive-thaw rejection (A-1..A-4) preserved with NO regression; the A-1 comment-inclusion change does not over-restrict legitimate additive thaws. D-007 independent re-verify held; no forged founder row (coder honestly blocked). HOWEVER the r1a fix introduced ONE new blocking hole R2-1: a hardcoded `SELFTEST_SKIP` corpus_ref sentinel that bypasses the entire corpus-anchor check is honored UNCONDITIONALLY from the JSON sanction line with no self-test-mode gating — a live auto_additive sanction can carry corpus_ref:"SELFTEST_SKIP" and silently skip the R-1a binding, partially reopening the exact hole this commit closed. Bounded (A-1..A-4 + R-1b + enemy_segment still hold, so not a destructive bypass) but on the security meta-gate the corpus-anchor integrity is load-bearing → changes_requested with a small fix (gate the sentinel to self-test invocation only; reject it in live mode). Plus 3 nits: substring (not exact) family-basename match (latent, 0 live collisions), 'byte-equivalent' wording (carried), ADR §4 comment-freeze deviation should be reflected in the ADR. Approve bar not met: the additional remaining item R2-1 is a code defect, not the founder bootstrap.
